decisions.name: 李香琴
decisions.reason: Source caption says 粵劇名伶李香琴穿用的白底綠膠片大靠, i.e. a costume/object worn by the artist, not a verified photograph of the artist's face. Filename contains the name but does not prove the depicted person. No face crop. Do not stage or count.

decisions.name: 秦沛
decisions.reason: Caption explicitly mentions Paul Chun Pui 秦沛, but image is a Causeway Bay street/minibus scene and automatic detector says face too small. Must inspect actual saved pixels, target location, source page, and 600x720 eye/nose/mouth/chin/full crop before considering. No game crop.

decisions.name: 田蕊妮
decisions.reason: Original 1490x2116 and filename 田蕊妮.jpg, but caption is only 2013萬千星輝頒獎典禮最佳女主角; confirm photo actually depicts the actress, am730's underlying CC BY 3.0 license/source, and a usable frontal 600x720 crop. No face auto-crop.

decisions.name: 陳錦鴻
decisions.reason: Original only 268x401 pixels, below 600x720 game target; detector reports face too small. Even if the caption and Wikidata P18 point to actor 陳錦鴻, upscaling would not provide adequate eye-only recognizability. Seek a sharper licensed portrait.
